scope: Replace a shell-dependent test diagnostic with the supported Windows Toolhelp API; preserve original Node rejection and cancellation behavior.

observed_hosted_failure.mechanism: Starting a PowerShell subprocess to inspect the current process exceeded the existing five-second timeout.

primary_sources.reviewed_contract: Acquire a thread snapshot, initialize THREADENTRY32, traverse entries, filter owner PID and close the acquired handle.
Use the documented seven-field structure and report actual thread IDs and base priorities.
Distinguish normal ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES termination from an enumeration error.

qualification.diagnostic_probe: With shell discovery unavailable and subprocess.run forbidden, the original helper returned no snapshot; the revised helper returned native thread entries for the current process.
qualification.handle_contract: Close exactly an acquired snapshot, including when enumeration raises; do not close an invalid handle.

limits: Toolhelp does not provide wait states or per-thread CPU time; these fields are explicitly unavailable.
Focused checks do not establish complete hosted acceptance or host-wide absence of leaks.
No model trials, token-saving percentage or agent-effectiveness claim follows from this change.
